title: coleus zeylanicus
intro: Coleus zeylanicus, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary purposes, providing health benefits such as antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in treating wounds and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Coleus zeylanicus include its ability to act as a carminative, relieving flatulence and indigestion, and its use as a diaphoretic, aiding in the treatment of fever and sweating. The bioactive constituents of Coleus zeylanicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
